biteOfDay: ing Trout fishing on Lake Taneycomo has improved noticeably. Good numbers of rainbows are present throughout the upper lake compared to summer, and brown trout are making a strong fall appearance, especially in the trophy stretch below the dam. tip: Insider tip: During any low or moderating flow windows on Taneycomo, target seams and current breaks with a 1/16- to 1/8-oz marabou micro jig in black, sculpin or olive (Indy orange head favorite), a zebra midge (#16–20 in red or black), or scud under an indicator.
